items.text: Seahawks place rookie RB Jadarian Price on IR (chest, aggravated practice); misses min 4 weeks. Signed Velus Jones Jr from PS.
items.why: Chest injury aggravated; first-round pick sidelined long-term.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups/rosters short-term; SEA RB depth chart shuffle.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining backs (Charbonnet also OUT per ETR); Velus Jones opportunity.

items.text: Colts downgrade Keenan Allen to OUT (groin) vs Commanders in London; elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine.
items.implication: Downs primary WR target share boost.
items.opportunity: Downs 31% targets recent, red-zone; Warren TE too.

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT; opens major opportunity for Jordan Addison home vs borderline secondary/MIA.
items.why: ETR list and Levitan: moment Addison truthers waited for.
items.opportunity: Addison primary target share elevation, routes, red-zone.

items.text: Devonta Smith and Dallas Goedert OUT (plus Baun); Eagles offense significantly worse vs Rams.
items.why: ETR list; Levitan: without three most important players (Smith/Goedert/Baun).
items.implication: Downgrade Eagles pass game/Hurts slightly; look to Wicks or other beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining WRs/TEs like Dontayvion Wicks; Ertz elevated.

items.text: Zay Flowers, Terry McLaurin, Mike Evans all QUESTIONABLE; monitor early/late windows and warmups closely.
items.why: ETR list; McLaurin late hamstring, Evans intends but GTD per prior, Flowers hamstring.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Likely/Andrews or WAS backups, Godwin etc elevate.

items.text: Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE (foot); went LP-DNP-LP, already had cracked rib earlier.
Jordan Addison massive opportunity home vs borderline secondary with Jefferson OUT; truthers moment.
Puka Nacua listed IN for Week 4 after hip issue; returns vs Eagles with possible snap limits per speculation.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury list; Levitan notes great to have back but snap limits possible.
items.implication: Start with slight volume caution first game back.
items.opportunity: Primary WR role resumes; red-zone/targets likely elevated vs depleted Eagles secondary.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN returning from hamstring; excellent matchup vs Cowboys per Levitan DvP.
items.why: Full participant Friday, no designation; Cowboys inflate opp WR scoring 7.3% most in NFL; Texans high implied points.
items.opportunity: High target share in favorable DvP and game script.

items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (season-ending ACL context from reports); Jaylen Wright among INs as beneficiary.
items.why: ETR list; broader reports torn ACL, IR.
items.implication: MIA backfield to Wright/others; Achane drop in most formats.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad/thigh); AD Mitchell also OUT opening Wilson targets.
items.why: ETR comprehensive list; Berry notes no Mitchell for Wilson.
items.implication: Braelon Allen lead back; Wilson target spike.
items.opportunity: Wilson 36% target share prior without Mitchell; Allen snaps/carries.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow); Mariota starting for WAS.
items.implication: Sit Daniels; Mariota streamer in some spots.
items.opportunity: McLaurin (if plays) or other WAS pass catchers volume with backup QB.

items.text: D'Andre Swift, Bucky Irving, Tony Pollard all listed IN; clear to play full roles.
items.why: ETR Sunday list after practice progress.
items.implication: Start as normal; no limitations expected.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out again; CLE allows yards to RBs every game.
corroboration: ETR Pollard IN but Dowdle context prior

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson (no Mitchell, 36% prior TS), Josh Downs (31% TS, RZ, WAS soft), George Kittle (climbing share, Evans day-to-day).
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for Wilson/Downs; Kittle TE1 upside.

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches last week (more than W1+2), RB5 util, double-digit target share every game; NYG soft vs RBs.
items.why: Featured role emerging; great util and matchup.

items.text: LOVE Drake London: 35% career TS with Penix, 43.5% last week (9-194); NO allows TDs to WRs.
HATE Omarion Hampton (low util 42% snaps, 3.5% TS, SEA stout vs RB), Justin Herbert (pressure/SEA D), Kyle Pitts (low with Penix), Emeka Egbuka, Xavier Worthy (Rice climbing).
items.why: Poor usage, tough matchups, low implied, role erosion.
items.opportunity: Hampton limited third-down/routes; Worthy aDOT/share down.
